_comment: 生成物，别手改。scripts/export-codex.ts 从 data/vanilla/units、unit-texts.json 与 vanilla-assets.json 生成。

desc.zh: 潮風商社将购自帝国的陆行船进行了改装，并让乘载的士兵装备了更为致命的火器。
desc.en: The Shiokaze Trading Company refitted land ships purchased from the Empire and equipped their crews with deadlier firearms.

story.zh: 陆行船本是旧世界玛丽恩堡商董们斥资打造的蒸汽坦克替代方案，后被帝国军队量产。潮風商社曾花费大量东方珍宝购入了少量陆行船和设计图纸。那些帝国人或许从没想过那时还名不见经传的尼朋人真的能再次造出陆行船——但无论如何，她们做到了。配合从群山王国获得的喷火器械，潮風陆行船将是比原版更为暴力的战争机器。
story.en: Land ships were first devised at great expense by Marienburg's merchant princes as an alternative to steam tanks, before the Imperial army began producing them in quantity. The Shiokaze Trading Company once spent great treasures from the East to acquire a small number of land ships and their blueprints. Those Imperials may never have imagined that the then little-known Nipponese would build land ships again—but they did. Fitted with flamethrowers acquired from the Dwarf realms, the Shiokaze Land Ship will be an even more brutal war machine than the original.

desc.zh: 武装团成员融汇多方战法，总能躲避最凶猛的火力。
desc.en: The Armed Company's fighters draw on many fighting traditions, always finding a way to evade the fiercest fire.

desc.zh: 『把所有的动力都投入引擎——时间紧迫！』
desc.en: "All power to the engines – time is of the essence!"

desc.zh: 陆行船的发动机无疑是技术上的奇迹，但众所周知，它们高度易燃…
desc.en: While the Land Ship's engines are undoubtedly marvels of technology, they're also known to be highly combustible…

desc.zh: 即使是最强大的敌人，也无法在身受重伤时屹立，而且所受伤害越大，他们的战斗力就会越为低下
desc.en: Even the greatest foes can be laid low with terrible injuries, and the greater the damage done, the less able they will be to effectively continue the fray.
